description: Bring the exact observed native window forward and verify foreground ownership. Observe again before input. Never use this to fight user takeover; wait for hand-back.
Observe one explicit native window with accessible controls and a focused image. Copy target.windowHandle from snapshot/window list; image:false returns text only.

Run verified steps against one explicit native window within the configured Control limits (32 steps by default). Read catalog for active budgets. Actions: observe, click, fill, select, check, expand, press, scroll, drag, wait. expect waits for an actual result; when enables conditional steps. Use stable automationId/runtimeId when a field's name changes with its value. Advanced tools remain available through help:list.
Read the live core/advanced tool catalog and device support. Neither section is restricted by model tier.
Read the current owner, target, action and user pause. Resume from the local Bridge panel.
Read a compact redacted local problem report. Nothing is automatically shared.

Look at the foreground native window. Returns unique refs, roles, names, physical bounds and window identity. Refresh after scrolling, moving windows or changing dialogs; refs expire after 30 seconds or a new snapshot.
Click an exact ref from the latest snapshot. The Bridge checks window, element identity and unchanged bounds before input. On stale_observation, snapshot again. Verify the app changed as expected.
Type literal Unicode into the focused field. Prefer its fresh ref after clicking it. Returns dispatched/unverified; read the field value afterward. Use hotkey for shortcuts.
Send native keys or a shortcut. Observe the result. Text belongs in the type action.
Scroll at the pointer or an observed physical virtual-screen point. Positive clicks scroll up, negative down. Refresh the snapshot afterward.
Drag between observed physical virtual-screen points. The large pointer follows actual input. Hold Escape to cancel. Verify the drop afterward.
